tool.name: Biomformat Convert
tool.description: Convert biom table to different format. Conversion between text tab-delimited, BIOM-v1 (JSON), and BIOM-v2 (HDF5) formats are supported

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use
